name: Nachtflohmarkt Rostock

rhythm.en: Twice a year, on a Saturday

facts: indoors in the HanseMesse, twice a year
the hall is heated, lit and can be driven into
the organiser counts over 1,000 dealers and 25,000 visitors so far
the organiser calls it the only indoor flea market in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern at this hour
old toys, instruments, books, paintings, jewellery, coins, porcelain, furniture and GDR-era pieces
entry 3 EUR, children up to 14 free
new goods and clearance stock are not allowed
about 2,000 parking spaces in front of the hall; the venue charges its own parking fee
notes: One date falls in this window, 24 October 2026; the organiser says the market runs twice a year and has published nothing for 2027 yet. The same organiser runs a separate "IGA Flohmarkt Rostock" at another Rostock site, and the Cottbus and Magdeburg night markets. Coordinates from Nominatim for the HanseMesse.

description.de: Zweimal im Jahr samstags von 15 bis 22 Uhr in der HanseMesse, geheizt und beleuchtet. Altes Spielzeug, Instrumente, Bücher, Bilder, Schmuck, Münzen, Porzellan, Möbel und Dinge aus DDR-Zeiten. Neuware und Restposten sind nicht zugelassen. Eintritt 3 Euro, Kinder bis 14 frei; rund 2.000 Parkplätze vor der Halle.
description.en: Twice a year on a Saturday from 3 to 10 at night in the HanseMesse, heated and lit. Old toys, instruments, books, paintings, jewellery, coins, porcelain, furniture and GDR-era pieces. New goods and clearance stock are not allowed. Entry 3 euros, under-14s free; around 2,000 parking spaces outside.
